name: Inavolisib + Palbociclib + Fulvestrant (INAVO120)
cyclesNote: Cycled every 28 days continuously until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.primaryStudy: INAVO120: Turner NC, Im SA, Saura C, et al. N Engl J Med 2024;391:1584-1596; Jhaveri KL, et al. N Engl J Med 2025;393:151-161

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-Q 6, 14 of 15)

biomarkers.note: Requires HR-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with a confirmed PIK3CA activating mutation and disease progression on or within 12 months of adjuvant endocrine therapy completion. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-Q (6 of 15 and 14 of 15) (Category 1, Preferred).

supportiveCare: Hyperglycemia prophylaxis/management: check fasting glucose and HbA1c at baseline. Monitor glucose levels regularly. Initiate metformin if FPG exceeds 160 mg/dL.
Stomatitis prophylaxis: consider steroid mouth rinse (dexamethasone 0.5 mg/5 mL) starting on Day 1 to prevent mucositis.
Neutropenia monitoring (Palbociclib): monitor CBC on Day 1 and Day 15 of early cycles.
Premenopausal patients must receive concurrent ovarian function suppression (GnRH analog).
monitoring: Fasting plasma glucose at baseline, Day 8, Day 15, Day 28, then monthly
HbA1c at baseline and every 3 months
CBC with differential prior to starting, on Day 15 of first 2 cycles, and before each cycle
Comprehensive metabolic panel / LFTs before each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Hold inavolisib. Initiate/intensify antidiabetic therapy. Resume at reduced dose (6 mg daily) when fasting glucose ≤ 160 mg/dL.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 neutropenia on Day 1 of cycle
doseModificationRules.text: Hold palbociclib until ANC ≥ 1000/mcL. Resume at 125 mg or reduce to 100 mg for prolonged or recurrent grade 3.

drugs.name: Inavolisib
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15. Inavolisib 9 mg PO once daily on Days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle.

drugs.name: Palbociclib
drugs.notes: Palbociclib 125 mg PO once daily on Days 1 to 21 of each 28-day cycle (7 days off).

drugs.name: Fulvestrant
drugs.notes: Fulvestrant 500 mg IM (two 250 mg injections) on Days 1 and 15 of Cycle 1, then Day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle.
